Answer: C
Reason: The large, dense opacity in the left upper zone has a convex medial border (D-shaped configuration) characteristic of a loculated pleural effusion (empyema necessitans or fissural collection), and the blunted costophrenic angle indicates concurrent free pleural fluid; this pattern is distinct from the air-bronchograms of pneumonia or the air-fluid level of an abscess.
